title: Cis-regulatory annotation of the feline renal cortex and the tissue-specificity shift in chronic kidney disease: analysis code
description: Analysis pipeline combining replicated ChIP-seq peak sets from seven domestic cat tissues with published renal expression matrices, to annotate promoter and enhancer architecture in the feline renal cortex and to characterise the tissue breadth of regulatory elements associated with genes that change in chronic kidney disease. Includes the permutation control that detects silent assembly discordance between feline datasets. Primary data are not included and are downloaded by the scripts from GEO and NCBI.
